scope: VB Frame caption and nested-container boundary audit.
actual_source_basis: Mouse VB5/VB6: Frame fraTest has caption Test Frame, a TextBox child and a windowless Label child.
PhotoAlbum VB6 source: Frame1 contains FileListBox, DriveListBox and DirListBox; its admitted executable/runtime identity remains the existing S14 VB5 mismatch and is not used as a VB6 runtime proof.
The authentic S4 runtime inventory contains runtime-owned ThunderRT5/6Frame and nested PictureBox/OptionButton paths.
renderer_boundary: ntw16s_vb_frame admits only exact runtime-owned Frame HWNDs and maps its public group-box protocol to the existing BUTTON painter. Child HWNDs are separately classified; windowless Labels stay in the parent's scoped DC text path. Visibility and enablement remain native runtime state, rather than being propagated by a renderer-side global operation.
existing_tests: core-vb creates an exact runtime-owned Frame and asserts attachment alongside the child controls; S4 authentic x86 observations preserve frame font/geometry while verifying nested PictureBox, OptionButton and CheckBox behavior. S9 covers scoped PictureBox text/DC ownership.
result: No product change. Caption, nested-child ownership and state semantics already match the limited public protocol. The source-only PhotoAlbum runtime mismatch prevents any broader VB6 File/Drive conclusion.
not_covered: Dynamic VB container Load/Unload without an admitted runnable sample.
Private Frame appearance or application-owned drawing.
